name: Air-Fryer Soya Nuggets
ingredients: 60 g dry soy chunks (mini or large)
1 tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp each garam masala and cumin
steps: Soak the soy chunks in hot salted water for 10 minutes, rinse and squeeze very dry.
Mix the yogurt, besan, cornflour, ginger-garlic paste, spices and salt; coat the soy chunks.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C and spray the basket.
Cook in a single layer for 14–16 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp.
Serve with lemon and mint chutney.
note: Soy chunks are among the most protein-dense plant foods; squeezing them dry removes the beany flavour and allows crisping.
